text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a 12-18% p50 regression on Mixtral-8x when we flipped kernel routing to prefer fp8-fused kernels for AWQ int8 profiles. Repro on staging.

jia: hmm, did you run with kv-prefetch enabled? that can interact with batch windows.

alex: yes kv-prefetch=on. batcher config: max_batch=32, latency_slo=60ms, microbatch=4. Repro steps and a tiny trace below.

matt: can you paste the perf trace from the perf bot? want to see where time moved.

perf-bot: trace summary for thread 1963456789:
- total tokens: 12k
- avg latency (baseline kernel): 48.2ms
- avg latency (new routing): 55.4ms
- kernel time delta: +11% in attention + KV lookup +3%
- batching efficiency: dropped from 0.92 -> 0.78

alex: attaching short CPU/GPU timeline from nvprof:
```
GPU kernel: flash_attn_fp8_fused  18.2ms
GPU kernel: matmul_int8_awq       10.1ms
KV cache lookup + gather         3.6ms
CUDA memcpy                      1.4ms
overhead (scheduler)             4.1ms
```

jia: interesting — flash_attn_fp8_fused is faster per-op but seems to prevent continuous batching (more small batches) because kernel selection happens per-request and disables some kernel-level fusion. so effective throughput down.

sam: that matches a local experiment: when routing prefers per-op fp8-fused kernels we lose the multi-request concat path. For Mixtral heads=32 kv_dim=128 we actually see worse headwise memory locality.

matt: hypothesis: AWQ int8 profile + fp8-fused kernel combo causes the runtime to avoid continuous batching to preserve quant layout, so we get smaller effective batch sizes. can we force kv-warmup or change prefetch window?

alex: tried kv_warmup=1000 (tokens) and prefetch_window=50ms. p50 improved to 50.1ms but still +4% vs baseline. Batching efficiency up to 0.85.

jia: can we try alternative kernel selection rule: prefer kernel that supports concat/batched path even if slightly slower single-op latency. small config snippet: 
```
serving.runtime.kernel_priority = ["batched_fp8", "batched_int8_awq", "fused_fp8"]
serving.runtime.kv_prefetch.enabled = true
serving.runtime.prefetch.window_ms = 60
```

perf-bot: A/B test scheduled between 1963457000-1963457600 using rule set v3-kernel-prio. Will collect p50/p95 and batching efficiency.

sam: calibration note — AWQ calibration prompts matter. I used 10 calibration prompts drawn from mixtral-longseq set and saw AWQ bias shift in logits ~0.6% after re-calib; small but could affect rerankers.

matt: actionable plan: 1) run A/B for kernel_priority v3 2) run AWQ recalib with 50 diverse prompts (mixtral-longseq + short chat) 3) evaluate continuous batching unlocker that allows fused kernels to accept concatenated inputs 4) collect headwise memory traces.

alex: +1 — I'll kick off A/B and attach experiment IDs here. if v3 recovers latency and batching efficiency, we'll ship as default for Mixtral AWQ. otherwise we'll roll back routing flag.

jia: also add a test that runs with RoPE_scale=0.98 vs 1.0 for mixtral longseq — earlier change in RoPE scaling impacted attention norm and changed memory access pattern a bit. might be a contributing factor.

alex: good call. starting jobs: exp=exp-196345-a, recalib=cal-196345-b, ropetest=rope-196345-c. will post metrics when available. :eyes:
